title: Sweet Corn Arepas with Blueberries and Farmer’s Cheese
excerpt: Enjoy delicious sweet corn arepas with fresh blueberries and farmer’s cheese, the perfect breakfast to treat your family.
imageAlt: Golden sweet corn arepas split open with whole blueberries and melted farmer’s cheese on a plate.
steps: In a large bowl, mix the corn dough with the sugar, salt and melted butter.
Add the warm milk little by little while kneading by hand until you get a soft, even dough.
Fold in the grated farmer’s cheese and the high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca, mixing gently so the fruit doesn’t break up too much.
Divide the dough into equal portions and shape them into balls by hand, then flatten them gently into arepa shapes.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat with a touch of butter.
Place the arepas and cook for 4 to 5 minutes on each side, until golden and crisp on the outside.
tips: Store your blueberries in the fridge unwashed and in their original packaging to keep their natural bloom intact and keep them fresh longer.
If you prefer a sweeter touch, you can serve the arepas with a drizzle of honey.
Be sure to fold the blueberries in at the end of kneading so they keep their shape and juicy texture when you bite into the arepa.
